query:
INSERT INTO room_favorites (user_id, room_id)
             SELECT rm.user_id, rm.room_id
             FROM room_members rm
             JOIN rooms r ON r.id = rm.room_id
             WHERE rm.user_id = $1
               AND rm.room_id = $2
               AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
             ON CONFLICT (user_id, room_id) DO NOTHING
